column1: # autoqc_predictors.tsv: the predictors of the post QC prediction layer
#   (cmig_autoqc_predictors.py), one row per column or pattern
# modality  fsurf, t2, dmri, fmri (the manual post QC table it predicts)
# type      exact (column is a full column name), pattern (column is a
#           regular expression, full match), mahal (a column of the
#           Mahalanobis table, full match; skipped when no such table is
# task      blank for session columns; rest, mid, sst, nback for per-task
#           fMRI columns (a missing task: a 0/1 indicator; raw QC columns
#           the median of the session's other tasks, else the cohort median)
# rules     post QC (mr_y_qc__post__aut): numeric automatic columns, not
#           strings, the FreeSurfer version, scan counts, or columns defined
#           for almost no session; raw QC (mr_y_qc__raw__*): only the __ok_
#           columns (summaries over the ok series), not the ok counts
#           (manual raw QC derived), sums over the ok series (fdsub) or
#           acquisition parameters (TR, frames, voxel volume); motion
#           (mr_y_qc__mot): dMRI and rsfMRI means and maxima, tfMRI the
#           mean FD over the deconvolution's frames (fdsub__09), not
#           counts, dof or TR; no manual QC columns
